title: PPS as the space of the bodily self
citation: Noel, J.-P., Pfeiffer, C., Blanke, O., & Serino, A. (2015). Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self. Cognition, 144, 49-57.
notes: Audio-tactile PPS task intermingled with full-body-illusion stroking. This ready profile captures the front-space main PPS trial schedule with chest vibration and source-backed synchronous/asynchronous stroking block labels. The separate back-space experiment still needs its own back-space/back-tactile variant before the full front/back expected-outcome contrast can be compared.

provenance.source: Methods lines report 72 PPS trials, 24 baseline trials, and 12 catch trials per block.
Methods lines report six sound distances D6-D1 with tactile timing corresponding to the spatial dimension.
Manual review records synchronous and asynchronous visuo-tactile stroking as separate counterbalanced blocks for the front-space chest-vibration experiment.
